prompt: Match each comparison to its result when x is 5.
explain: == asks whether two values are equal; != asks whether they differ. Neither changes x.

prompt: Match each keyword to when it runs.
right: Only when every test above it was False
First, when its test is True
Repeats for as long as its test stays True
When the test above was False and its own test is True
explain: elif is only reached when the if above it was False. else has no test of its own.

prompt: Which of these will run the body of the loop at least once?
explain: range(0) is empty, so that loop body never runs, and `while False` never starts.

prompt: Fill the blank so the loop counts 0, 1, 2, 3, 4.
